summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) filed a Form 6-K disclosing progress on its common stock repurchase program. Under a board resolution dated May 15, 2026, it authorized buybacks of up to 45 million shares (0.40% of outstanding) for up to ¥100 billion through June 30, 2026. As of May 31, 2026, it had repurchased 10.72 million shares for ¥32.83 billion via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The transaction is a routine capital return, with no recommendation or advisor named. What to watch: pace of repurchase against the ¥100 billion authorization.
